title: Instant heal GameplayEffect + heal ability
prompt: Using the Gameplay Ability System, create an instant GameplayEffect {root}/GE_Heal that adds 25 to AbilitySystemTestAttributeSet.Health, and a GameplayAbility {root}/GA_Heal whose ability tags include Ability.Heal.

tools.name: instant +25 Health
tools.expect: r['success'] and r['duration_policy'] == 'INSTANT' and len(r['modifiers']) == 1 and r['modifiers'][0]['attribute'] == 'AbilitySystemTestAttributeSet.Health' and r['modifiers'][0]['op'] in ('AddBase', 'Additive') and r['modifiers'][0]['magnitude'] == 25

tools.name: ability tagged Ability.Heal
tools.expect: r['success'] and r['class'] == 'GameplayAbility' and 'Ability.Heal' in r['ability_tags']
